                                A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {

clauses.clause: [+1]: Look at the top four cards of your library.
You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand.
Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
[−3]: Destroy target artifact, enchantment, or creature with flying.
[−8]: You get an emblem with "Creatures you control get +2/+2 and have vigilance, trample, and indestructible."

mapping.notes: Re-mapped by ontology gate round W3 (DESIGN_ATOM_ONTOLOGY §20) from the stored tree: "reveal ... from among them and put it into your hand": the move's pick, then reveal_result(). Nothing else changed.
